name: twikit
description: Twikit documentation. Async Python wrapper for Twitter/X internal API — no API key required. Covers Client login (auth_info_1/auth_info_2/password/TOTP/cookies), tweets (create/delete/like/retweet/bookmark, search, get_tweet_by_id), users (get_user_by_id/screen_name, follow/block/mute, followers/following), DMs, lists, communities, notifications, trends, media upload, polls, rate limits, and account-protection guidance.

_source._reason: Hybrid source. The full API reference (twikit.html) is Sphinx-generated on ReadTheDocs and only available rendered — the upstream docs/twikit.rst is autodoc directives that need a Sphinx build to be useful. README/ratelimits/account-safety markdown files come from the GitHub root. Built manually with `pandoc -f html -t gfm-raw_html` (the script default `-t markdown` produces noisy pandoc-extended output for Sphinx pages); rebuilds will need the same custom invocation plus a strip pass for the Sphinx U+F0C1 headerlink glyph.
